name: Stick War Legacy Reborn (Bug fixes/Optimization)
desc:
The original game was removed by Roblox, which is why I had to delete all content in the game that doesn't comply with Roblox rules.


Remember, the game isn't ready yet! This is just a test place with character models and animations, but it does have a combat system that makes the game playable. Exploiting is allowed until you not start disturbing others while they play
